references.text: The context of the event where Ehud locked the doors to the hall after killing Eglon, which led to the servants' confusion in verse 25
Samuel waited for Saul until the agreed time, a similar theme of waiting with anxiety and uncertainty
David's servants hesitated to tell him about the child's death, similar hesitation and fear of bringing bad news
Ben-Hadad's servants waited anxiously for an answer from the king of Israel, similar anxious waiting
Encouragement to go into rooms and close the doors, a thematic link to closed doors and hidden events
